items.titleZh: 特朗普在美伊紧张局势升级之际支持皮特·赫格塞斯——事件回顾
items.summaryZh: 特朗普表示已暂停对伊朗的军事打击以给予外交机会，但强调若外交失败将采取强硬军事行动。同时，他重申了对以色列的支持。
items.whyImportant: 美国在外交与军事手段之间的摇摆，对中东地区的局势稳定具有决定性影响。

items.title: Drivers struggle through floods in Hong Kong’s New Territories amid heavy rain
items.summary: Heavy rain has led to flooding in some parts of Hong Kong’s New Territories, with some drivers struggling to navigate waterlogged roads in Tai Po even as the Observatory cancelled the amber rainstorm warning on Tuesday morning. The amber warning, earlier issued at 7.15am, meant that more than 30mm of rain had fallen in an hour, or was expected to fall generally over Hong Kong within that period and was likely to continue. The weather forecaster also warned of flooding in some low-lying and...
items.titleZh: 香港新界暴雨引发洪水，司机艰难通行
items.summaryZh: 香港新界地区因强降雨出现洪水，导致部分道路积水，司机通行困难。天文台此前曾发出黄色暴雨警告，并提醒低洼地区注意防范。
items.whyImportant: 极端天气对香港的交通和城市基础设施造成了直接影响，考验着城市的防灾应对能力。

items.title: CATL-backed smart driving tech firm to kick off Hong Kong IPO this week: sources
items.summary: NASN Intelligent Tech, a mainland Chinese smart driving motion control technologies company, is seeking to kick off its initial public offering (IPO) as soon as Thursday, according to people familiar with the matter. The company, backed by battery giant Contemporary Amperex Technology Ltd (CATL), recently passed its listing hearing, signalling it could kick off its book building anytime. Debuts are scheduled for August 7, the sources said, requesting not to be identified as the information is...
items.titleZh: 宁德时代支持的智能驾驶技术公司将于本周启动香港IPO
items.summaryZh: 获得宁德时代支持的智能驾驶技术公司NASN Intelligent Tech计划最早于本周启动在港上市程序。该公司已通过上市聆讯，预计将于8月7日正式挂牌。
items.whyImportant: 科技企业在港上市的动态反映了资本市场对中国智能驾驶领域的持续关注与投资信心。

items.title: Police say there were at least 3 shooters at Seattle food festival, 1 among the dead
items.summary: Police now say there were at least three suspects involved in a shoot-out at a crowded food festival near Seattle’s Space Needle over the weekend. One of them was among those killed in the violence. In a document filed in juvenile court in Seattle, where a 15-year-old arrested in the case did not appear for a scheduled initial appearance on Monday, police said they believe there were at least three shooters, rather than two: the 15-year-old; an acquaintance who died at the scene; and “at least...
items.titleZh: 警方称西雅图美食节至少有3名枪手，其中1人死亡
items.summaryZh: 警方调查显示，西雅图美食节枪击案涉及至少三名嫌疑人，其中包括一名已在现场死亡的同伙。目前一名15岁嫌疑人已被捕。
items.whyImportant: 该起公共场所枪击事件再次引发了美国社会对于青少年暴力和公共安全管控的讨论。

items.title: UK’s Burnham meets Zelensky, pledges ‘Stone Cloak’ tech for Ukraine’s drones
items.summary: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham held his first meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky at a UK naval base on Monday, pledging new “Stone Cloak” jamming technology to help safeguard Ukraine’s drones on the battlefield. The meeting on the dockside and on board an aircraft carrier in the southern city of Portsmouth was Burnham’s first bilateral with a foreign leader and comes ahead of a visit by Zelensky to Washington on Tuesday aimed at ending the four-year war with Russia. “We are...
items.titleZh: 英国首相伯纳姆会见泽连斯基，承诺为乌克兰无人机提供“石斗篷”技术
items.summaryZh: 英国首相伯纳姆与乌克兰总统泽连斯基举行会晤，承诺提供“石斗篷”干扰技术以保护乌军无人机。这是伯纳姆上任后的首次双边会晤。
items.whyImportant: 英国对乌克兰军事技术的支持，显示了其在俄乌冲突中持续发挥关键作用的立场。

items.title: China’s localised data centre push drives AI ambitions amid overbuilding concerns
items.summary: Despite their strikingly different approaches to developing and deploying artificial intelligence, one aspect is common across China and the United States: data and computing centres are proliferating in both countries, especially in remote locations. While the US is seeing residents and localities fight back against plans for data centres in their backyards, regional officials in China are embracing them. In fact, in China there is a nationwide scramble for such facilities – considered the...
items.titleZh: 中国推动本地化数据中心建设，在过度建设担忧中追求人工智能雄心
items.summaryZh: 尽管面临过度建设的担忧，中国各地政府仍积极推动数据中心建设以支持人工智能发展。与美国部分地区居民抵制数据中心不同，中国地方官员将其视为经济增长点。
items.whyImportant: 数据中心建设的差异化路径反映了中美两国在人工智能基础设施布局上的不同策略。

items.title: NASA Astronaut Chris Williams to Discuss Space Station Mission
items.summary: NASA astronaut Chris Williams will recap his recent eight-month mission aboard the International Space Station during a news conference at 2:45 p.m. EDT Tuesday, Aug. 4, from the agency’s Johnson Space Center in Houston. NASA will stream this event live through a variety of platforms. Learn where to watch online: https://www.nasa.gov/live United States-based media interested […]
items.titleZh: NASA宇航员克里斯·威廉姆斯将讨论空间站任务
items.summaryZh: NASA宇航员克里斯·威廉姆斯将于8月4日举行新闻发布会，回顾其在国际空间站执行的八个月任务。该活动将通过NASA平台进行直播。
items.whyImportant: 宇航员的任务回顾有助于公众了解空间科学研究的最新进展与成果。

items.titleZh: 澳大利亚新闻直播：本·卡罗尔在“高风险”选举前承诺维多利亚州新方向；莫伊拉·迪明退出自由党
items.summaryZh: 维多利亚州州长杰辛塔·艾伦在面临本·卡罗尔的领导权挑战前辞职。澳大利亚工会理事会主席米歇尔·奥尼尔宣布离职，称现在是领导层更新的合适时机。
items.whyImportant: 维多利亚州政坛的领导层更迭及工会高层的变动，正值该州面临严峻的财政和民生挑战，引发了对未来政策走向的广泛关注。

items.title: Who is Ben Carroll, the man who has become Victoria’s new premier?

Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 谁是本·卡罗尔，这位成为维多利亚州新州长的人？
items.summaryZh: 本·卡罗尔于2012年当选议员，在杰辛塔·艾伦辞职后宣誓就任州长。他曾于2023年竞选工党领导权失败，此次接任标志着他政治抱负的实现。
items.whyImportant: 作为维多利亚州的新任领导人，卡罗尔的背景和执政风格将直接影响该州在选举前的政治稳定与政策制定。

items.title: Ben Carroll becomes new premier of Victoria after Jacinta Allan resigns
items.summary: Allan stepped down from top job before expected spill, saying her deputy has her ‘unqualified support’ Live updates: Jacinta Allan quits as premier of Victoria Who is Ben Carroll? Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Ben Carroll has been sworn in as the premier of Victoria, after Jacinta Allan resigned and a surprise rival for the Labor leadership emerged after a tumultuous 48 hours for Labor just four months out from the state election. Speaking outside a party room meeting on Tuesday, Labor MP Juliana Addison announced that Carroll had been “unanimously endorsed by the state parliamentary Labor party as our next premier of Victoria”. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 杰辛塔·艾伦辞职后，本·卡罗尔成为维多利亚州新州长
items.summaryZh: 在州选举前四个月的动荡期内，杰辛塔·艾伦辞去州长职务，本·卡罗尔获得工党议会党团的一致支持。这一变动发生在工党内部激烈的领导权竞争之后。
items.whyImportant: 维多利亚州政府领导层的突然更迭，增加了该州在即将到来的选举中的政治不确定性。

items.summary: Jury finds that the man, who cannot be named, assaulted the woman at his home in March 2023 Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast A well-connected Melbourne man has been found guilty of raping a former employee. The man, who cannot be named, faced two counts of rape and one count of sexual assault in the county court of Victoria, and pleaded not guilty. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 墨尔本一名人脉广泛的男子被判强奸前员工罪名成立
items.summaryZh: 一名无法公开姓名的墨尔本男子因在2023年3月强奸其前员工，被维多利亚州法院裁定罪名成立。该男子此前面临两项强奸罪和一项性侵犯罪指控。
items.whyImportant: 此案因被告的社会背景及案件性质引发了公众对司法公正和职场性暴力问题的关注。

items.title: Trump says Iran talks taking place during pause in US military strikes
items.summary: The US president says "there is a good chance that something could happen", as Iran denies direct talks are taking place.
items.titleZh: 特朗普称在美国军事打击暂停期间正在与伊朗进行谈判
items.summaryZh: 美国总统表示，在暂停军事打击期间，美伊双方存在通过外交途径解决问题的可能性。伊朗方面则否认了双方正在进行直接对话的说法。
items.whyImportant: 美伊之间紧张局势的任何外交进展都对中东地区的和平与全球安全具有重大影响。

items.title: France and Spain race to contain huge wildfires before fresh heatwave begins
items.summary: Coming days are ‘absolutely critical’ for firefighters before temperatures rise again this week, officials say Firefighters in France and Spain are racing to bring huge wildfires under control before another heatwave this week that will complicate efforts to tame the flames. Spain’s interior minister, Fernando Grande-Marlaska, said Monday and Tuesday were “absolutely crucial days” before temperatures rise again from Wednesday, prompting prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, to warn: “We face difficult hours, complex hours” ahead. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 法国和西班牙竞相在新的热浪来临前控制大规模野火
items.summaryZh: 法国和西班牙的消防员正争分夺秒地扑灭大规模野火，以应对本周即将到来的新一轮热浪。官员们警告称，未来几天对于控制火势至关重要。
items.whyImportant: 极端高温天气加剧了欧洲的野火危机，对当地生态环境和公共安全构成了严重威胁。

items.title: Food court stalls caught off guard by rules over plastic serving containers
items.summary: Hong Kong environmental authorities have warned that restaurant operators must not use disposable tableware coated in plastic for dine-in service, after some owners told the South China Morning Post they were caught off guard by inspectors. The Environmental Protection Department on Monday clarified that paper products with an inner plastic lining could only be used for takeaway orders after a food stall owner at Dragon Centre in Sham Shui Po said he was “shocked” by a warning he...
items.titleZh: 美食广场摊位因塑料餐具规定措手不及
items.summaryZh: 香港环保署明确规定，堂食不得使用塑料涂层的一次性餐具，仅限外卖使用。部分餐饮业者表示对此规定感到意外，并对执法力度表示担忧。
items.whyImportant: 香港推行环保餐具政策的过程中，餐饮业者面临合规压力与经营成本的挑战。

items.title: Singapore-based investors now the top non-local buyers of Hong Kong office assets
items.summary: Singapore-based investors have become the largest group of non-local buyers of commercial properties in Hong Kong, drawn by the sizeable correction in the prices of distressed assets amid a slump in the city’s office segment, according to Colliers. The demand from Singapore was likely to remain steady in the coming months, given that the prices of office assets have declined by as much as 50 per cent, according to Thomas Chak, head of capital markets and investment services at the property...
items.titleZh: 新加坡投资者成为香港办公楼资产最大的非本地买家
items.summaryZh: 受香港办公楼市场价格大幅回调影响，新加坡投资者已成为该领域最大的非本地买家。分析认为，随着资产价格下跌，这种投资需求在未来几个月内将保持稳定。
items.whyImportant: 外资对香港商业地产的兴趣反映了市场对该地区资产价值重估的预期及资本流向的变化。

items.title: Armed police officers to be deployed for UK’s biggest Pride festival
items.summary: Armed officers will be deployed for the UK’s largest Pride festival, police said following the attack on Berlin’s Pride event. Defence Secretary Wes Streeting condemned the “absolutely horrific” van and stabbing attack in the German capital that left one person dead and injured at least 29 others. The suspect – named as Abdul B and said to have links to Islamic State – was shot dead by police on Sunday after being on the run for nearly 24 hours. He was suspected of slamming a van into people...
items.titleZh: 武装警察将被部署到英国最大的骄傲节活动中
items.summaryZh: 在柏林骄傲节发生致命袭击事件后，英国警方宣布将为国内最大的骄傲节部署武装警察。英国国防大臣对柏林的袭击事件表示强烈谴责。
items.whyImportant: 针对大型公共活动的安保升级，反映了欧洲当前面临的恐怖主义威胁及对社会安全的担忧。

items.title: In 1976, earthquake in China’s Tangshan kills over 240,000 people – SCMP archive
items.summary: This article was first published on July 29, 1976. Quake rocks Northern China by Staff Reporters Heavy casualties and severe damage to industrial plants and property were feared when the strongest earthquake for 12 years struck the industrial belt of northern Hopei Province early yesterday (July 28, 1976) morning. The tremor was followed by a series of aftershocks and 16 hours after the first quake, an aftershock of almost the same intensity struck the same area, causing further damage and...
items.titleZh: 1976年，中国唐山地震造成超过24万人死亡——南华早报档案
items.summaryZh: 1976年7月28日，中国河北省唐山地区发生强烈地震，造成重大人员伤亡和工业设施损毁。随后的余震进一步加剧了灾区的破坏程度。
items.whyImportant: 回顾历史灾难有助于铭记防灾减灾的重要性，并展示了中国在应对重大自然灾害方面的历史进程。

items.title: China turns to public for help in deadly dam collapse probe after Typhoon Maysak
items.summary: The Chinese government has appealed to the public for clues as part of its investigation into a reservoir dam that collapsed in southern China earlier this month, causing heavy casualties. State media reported on Monday that the public was invited to submit information related to the collapse of the Liulan Reservoir in Hengzhou, Guangxi Zhuang autonomous region on July 6 via a dedicated telephone hotline. People also have until August 15 to post submissions to an investigation and assessment...
items.titleZh: 台风“美莎克”后，中国就致命大坝坍塌事故向公众寻求调查线索
items.summaryZh: 中国政府就7月6日广西柳兰水库大坝坍塌事故向公众征集线索。当局设立了专门热线，并呼吁知情者在8月15日前提交相关信息。
items.whyImportant: 通过公众参与调查大坝事故，体现了政府对基础设施安全和事故问责的重视。

items.title: Brazil turns to China trade deal after Trump’s tariffs, as years of resistance end
items.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping and Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva agreed on Sunday night to accelerate negotiations for a trade agreement between China and Mercosur, a striking reversal for Brasilia, which for years led resistance to such a deal in the South American bloc. The two leaders spoke by telephone for more than an hour, according to a statement from the Brazilian presidency, and “coincided on the importance of speeding up the talks for a Mercosur-China agreement that...
items.titleZh: 在特朗普关税政策下，巴西结束多年抵制，转向与中国达成贸易协议
items.summaryZh: 巴西总统卢拉与中国国家主席习近平通话，同意加快南方共同市场与中国之间的贸易协议谈判。这一决定标志着巴西在贸易政策上的重大转变。
items.whyImportant: 巴西与中国加强贸易合作的意向，显示了全球贸易格局在关税压力下的重组与调整。

items.title: US walks out on France at UN over human rights criticism
items.summary: US diplomats walked out as their French counterparts were speaking at the United Nations on Monday after America’s close European ally criticised the Trump administration’s human rights record. The surprise move during a UN Security Council meeting on Ukraine followed US opposition to giving UN human rights chief Volker Turk another four-year term. The reappointment on Friday got overwhelming support, including from France. The US walkout reflects not only the more strained relations between...
items.titleZh: 美国在联合国就人权批评问题上对法国采取离场抗议
items.summaryZh: 在联合国安理会会议上，美国外交官因不满法国对其人权记录的批评而选择离场。此举反映了美法两国在人权议题及联合国人事任命上的分歧。
items.whyImportant: 美法外交摩擦凸显了西方盟友在国际多边机构中日益加剧的政策分歧。

items.title: Iran war live: Trump says ‘friendly’ talks ongoing; Netanyahu arrives in US
items.summary: Iran says US 'struggling' to end five-month-old war, as Netanyahu arrives in Washington, DC, for talks with Trump.
items.titleZh: 伊朗战争直播：特朗普称“友好”谈判正在进行；内塔尼亚胡抵达美国
items.summaryZh: 伊朗指责美国在结束战争方面进展缓慢，与此同时，内塔尼亚胡抵达华盛顿与特朗普进行会谈。双方正就当前局势进行外交接触。
items.whyImportant: 美伊及美以之间的密集外交活动，是决定中东冲突走向的关键因素。

items.title: US-Canada bridge opens in Detroit even as trade disputes test the neighbours’ ties
items.summary: A major new bridge linking Canada and the United States at Detroit, Michigan opened on Monday to lorries, cars and other vehicles, the climax of a years-long project that lately had been bruised a bit by international politics. Descendants of Gordie Howe, the hockey legend whose name is on the bridge, were among the first to cross over the Detroit River, which separates Detroit from Windsor, Ontario. The span, which was built by Canada at a cost of C$6.4 billion (US$4.5 billion), now becomes a...
items.titleZh: 美加底特律大桥开通，贸易争端考验邻国关系
items.summaryZh: 连接美国底特律和加拿大温莎的戈迪·豪大桥于周一正式通车。尽管该项目耗资巨大，但近期两国间的贸易争端为双边关系蒙上了阴影。
items.whyImportant: 新大桥的开通虽促进了物流，但美加之间持续的贸易摩擦仍是影响两国经济合作的主要障碍。

items.title: Presidential Message on National Korean War Veterans Armistice Day
items.summary: Today, our Nation marks the 82nd anniversary of the American liberation of Guam—the day the United States shattered a brutal occupation and carried freedom back to an island that had endured more than 2 years of suffering As our Nation observes National Korean War Veterans Armistice Day, we honor the extraordinary courage and devotion of […] The post Presidential Message on National Korean War Veterans Armistice Day appeared first on The White House.
items.titleZh: 总统关于朝鲜战争停战纪念日的致辞
items.summaryZh: 美国总统在纪念朝鲜战争停战纪念日之际，向参战老兵的勇气与奉献表示敬意。同时，致辞还提到了美国解放关岛82周年的纪念活动。
items.whyImportant: 总统的纪念致辞旨在强化国家历史记忆，并向退伍军人表达政府的认可与尊重。
